title: Basic Aeronautics Airship
author: Tommobean
usage: Unmodified author download used for owner-local testing. Public redistribution permission is not established by the author page or the site terms; do not publish the copied file without resolving that permission.
integration: Whole template printed through native Create APIs; per-vessel radio pairs, ordinary fuel and initial hot-air fill. Native swivel assembly creates explicitly tracked children; only bodies allocated in that tagged bearing call receive ownership, including later rebuilds and added bearings. Complete loaded membership and occupants are checked before reverse-order removal. Detached components follow native Sable splitting. No geometry is reconstructed.
